requirements.text: Skill purpose: convert an existing SKILL.md into checked SkillWren logic (complete skill, or flow files with logic blocks) preserving its requirements; validate flow and ordering, review parity, measure the complete loaded prompt.
lands: Produce a smaller, logically structured skill from an existing skill.

requirements.text: Produce a smaller, logically structured skill from an existing skill.
lands: write #candidate candidate with output

requirements.text: Keep the original skill intact (do not modify it).
lands: modify the original skill

requirements.text: Use this repository's compiler and validator; do not substitute token deletion or an expanded copy of the original for a semantic conversion.
lands: substitute token deletion or an expanded copy of the original for a semantic conversion

requirements.text: Step 1: read the original and its relevant local references; establish which files belong to the comparison.
lands: establish which files belong to the comparison (the original and its relevant local references)

requirements.text: Inventory obligations, prohibitions, conditions, exceptions, examples that affect decisions, evidence standards, and outputs.
lands: write #inventory inventory with review

requirements.text: Mark every 'do X before Y' ordering the original states or implies.
lands: apply inventory before apply rewrite

requirements.text: Choose target layout: flow files (small SKILL.md with only name, description, and a core, plus logic blocks in flows/*.md; start from docs/current/fragment-template.md) by default, UNLESS a tool you run reads the SkillWren header, in which case a complete skill (docs/current/skill-template.md).
lands: if a tool you run reads the SkillWren header:

requirements.text: Step 2: rewrite the procedure using the grammar in docs/current/SPEC.md: explicit branches, require/verify gates, bindings, effects, and bounded repairs.
lands: write #candidate candidate with output
apply repair with candidate as candidate

requirements.text: Put repeated cross-cutting rules once in the contract; keep specialized facts/examples only where they change decisions.
lands: put repeated cross-cutting rules once in the contract

requirements.text: Report appendix may define output shape; a second procedural glossary must not repeat the flow.
lands: a second procedural glossary must not repeat the flow

requirements.text: Write each marked ordering as an `order:` rule, and gate the earlier step on every path rather than only inside a conditionally called flow.
lands: write#candidate before exec#checkrun
gate the earlier step on every path

requirements.text: Step 3: preserve authority and failure behavior: do not turn review into editing, optional advice into a requirement, a conditional task into unconditional work, or an unavailable check into a passing result.
lands: preserve authority and failure behavior
turn review into editing, optional advice into a requirement

requirements.text: Retain concrete values, scope boundaries, and exceptions; a new name alone does not preserve a rule.
lands: retain concrete values, scope boundaries, and exceptions

requirements.text: Step 4: run `skillwren check candidate.md` for complete skills; for flow files run `skillwren check --fragment --summary flows/*.md`.
lands: exec #checkrun skillwren check from checks as checked

requirements.text: For flow files, review the inferred inputs for typos.
lands: verify #inputs the inferred inputs in the summary have no typos from checked

requirements.text: Without installing, use PYTHONPATH=src and the interpreter that works: python3, python, or py -3 on Windows.
lands: verify #interp the interpreter that works is python3, python, or py -3 from probe

requirements.text: On check findings, repair the represented control flow rather than weakening requirements just to silence a rule.
lands: verify #check the check reports no findings from checked

requirements.text: Consult docs/current/authoring-guide.md for conversion workflow and current limits.
lands: Consult `docs/current/authoring-guide.md`

requirements.text: Step 5: create a reviewed map in the format documented in docs/current/compiler.md, binding original and candidate hashes.
lands: write #map map with review

requirements.text: Map every original nonblank line to instructions that preserve its intent; explicitly include relevant original reference files.
lands: write #map map with review

requirements.text: Review the mapping semantically (anchor matching only checks bookkeeping).
lands: verify #parity every original nonblank line and relevant reference file is mapped and the mapping is reviewed semantically from mapchecked

requirements.text: Update the rewrite if anything is lost or invented.
lands: apply rewrite update with map as candidate

requirements.text: Step 6: run `skillwren measure original.md candidate.md --json`, adding one `--original-context FILE` per selected original reference.
lands: exec #measure skillwren measure from checks as measured

requirements.text: Measure the complete expanded prompt using the same tokenizer on both sides; character counts require an explicit metric and must not be called token savings.
lands: verify #metric the measure counts the complete expanded prompt with the same tokenizer on both sides and names an explicit metric for every count from measured
character counts require an explicit metric name stated with every count
call character counts token savings

requirements.text: Step 7 applies to complete skills only (flow-file sets are not built yet): run `skillwren build candidate.md --original original.md --review review.json --out compiled-skill` with the same context selection.
lands: exec #buildrun skillwren build from checks as built
if layout is complete skill:

requirements.text: Build must validate the flow, pass the review checks, and be strictly smaller before publication.
lands: verify #build the build validates the flow and passes the review checks from built
if the build is not strictly smaller than the original:
publish a build that failed validation, failed the review checks, or is not strictly smaller

requirements.text: If size target is difficult, preserve required behavior and report the tradeoff; do not silently drop content or hide it in deferred files.
lands: apply tradeoff record with built as limits
apply tradeoff record with measured as limits
silently drop content or hide it in deferred files

requirements.text: Optionally, to have a model do steps 1-5 with mechanical accounting, run `skillwren compile original.md --context ref.md ... --out candidate -- <adapter>`; it inventories every source line, lowers, checks, repairs, writes audit/inventory.json and audit/review.json.
lands: exec #compile skillwren compile from checks as compiled

requirements.text: Review compile's open findings, questions, and judge results exactly as for your own conversion.
lands: verify #creview open findings, questions, and judge results of the compile are reviewed from compiled

requirements.text: Return the compiled skill, retained-source manifest, requirement map, exact comparison metric and counts, and material limits.
lands: write #reportfile report with output
return #result report as report

requirements.text: State that structural validation and source retention do not prove semantic equivalence or model adherence.
lands: verify #final report lists the compiled skill

requirements.text: Do not run paid model evaluations or install the result unless requested.
lands: ask user to confirm paid model evaluation or installation of the result
require confirmation

requirements.text: Implied step order: inventory (1) → rewrite (2) → check (4) → map/review (5) → measure (6) → build (7, complete skills only).
lands: verify#check before write#map
verify#parity before exec#measure
exec#measure before exec#buildrun
